system.description:
Through patient, gentle counsel you reach into a troubled mind and lift the shadow of madness that darkens it.

Spend about ten minutes in uninterrupted, quiet conversation with the subject, expend two Blood Traits, and make a Static Mental Challenge against a difficulty of the subject's Mental Traits, retested with Medicine. On a success you alleviate one of the target's derangements: for most subjects the cure is permanent, but a Malkavian's core madness is only suppressed for the rest of the scene or the next hour. You cannot use Mens Sana to cure your own derangements.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
